description.value:
You transform your body into a Large battle form made of junk. When you cast this spell, choose e-waste, filth, or scrap. While in this form, you gain the tech trait. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which option you choose:

  • AC = 17 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction, but you can still use any armor upgrades or environmental protections you have.
  • Darkvision.
  • One or more unarmed attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +22, and your damage bonus is +6. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Enfeebled] condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.

You also gain abilities based on the battle form you choose:

  • E-Waste
    • Speed 25 feet (hover), fly 20 feet; Weaknesses bludgeoning 5; Resistances electricity 10.
    • Static Feedback (electricity) A creature that hits you with a melee Strike takes 1d4 electricity damage. If the weapon has the tech trait, they must succeed at a Reflex save against your spell DC or the weapon becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Glitching]{glitching 1}.
    • Melee 1 fan blade, Damage 2d6 slashing plus 2d6 electricity.
    • Ranged 1 power surge (range 60 feet), Damage 2d4 electricity plus 2d4 fire.
  • Filth
    • Speed 20 feet; Weaknesses slashing 5; Resistances poison 10.
    • Rancid Stench (aura, olfactory, poison) 10 feet. A creature that enters or starts their turn in the aura must succeed at a Fortitude save against your spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Sickened]{sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Sickened]{sickened 2} on a critical failure). Creatures can't retch to reduce their sickened value within the aura. If a creature succeeds, or once they recover from this sickened condition, it's temporarily immune to the aura for 24 hours.
    • Melee 1 sludge slug, Damage 2d8 bludgeoning plus 1d6 persistent poison.
    • Ranged 1 garbage dump (range 20 feet), Damage 2d6 bludgeoning plus 1d6 persistent poison.
  • Scrap
    • Speed 20 feet, climb 20 feet; Weaknesses electricity 5; Resistances slashing 10.
    • Melee 1 scrap slug, Damage 2d8 bludgeoning plus 2d8 slashing.
    • Ranged 1 scrap shot (range 60 feet), Damage 3d8 bludgeoning.

Heightened (8th) Your battle form is Huge, you gain a +15-foot status bonus to your Speeds, and your melee attacks have 10-foot reach. You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 15 temporary Hit Points, an attack modifier of +28, and a damage bonus of +12. Static feedback deals 2d4 electricity damage.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Junk Form]
